name: Video pipeline on AWS
note: A serverless pipeline for a crowdsourced video platform: contributors record on their phones, and uploads are transcoded and assembled into branded videos without anyone moving files by hand.
problem: Every crowdsourced submission needed manual uploading, transcoding, review and assembly. It worked for a few hundred users and broke down beyond that, and the team spent more time moving files than improving the product.

approach.title: Event-driven
approach.text: S3 uploads trigger Lambda functions, orchestrated through SQS.

approach.title: Async processing
approach.text: Heavy transcoding runs in background workers, so the app stays responsive under load.

approach.title: Zero ops
approach.text: No servers to manage: it scales with traffic and idles near zero cost between bursts.

approach.title: Durable state
approach.text: Job state, automatic retries and dead-letter handling, so failures are never silent.

approach.title: Live dashboard
approach.text: A React dashboard shows each submission’s status at every stage.

features: Video templates with intro, contributor and outro segments
Contributor invites by QR code and link
Record from a phone, no app needed

testimonial.quote: His communication was clear, regular and fast.
